description: This file contains a minified or bundled source map handling library, including classes and functions for source map parsing, source node creation, and position mapping, used within the Next.js project.

classes.name: ArraySet
classes.description: A custom set implementation using an array and optional Map for efficient storage and lookup.

classes.name: SourceMapConsumer
classes.description: A class for parsing and querying source maps, including methods for position translation and content retrieval.

classes.name: BasicSourceMapConsumer
classes.description: A basic implementation of SourceMapConsumer for standard source maps.

classes.name: IndexedSourceMapConsumer
classes.description: An implementation of SourceMapConsumer for source maps with multiple sections.

classes.name: SourceMapGenerator
classes.description: A class for creating and serializing source maps.

classes.name: SourceNode
classes.description: A class representing a source node, used for generating source maps with inline code and mappings.

methods.name: ArraySet_fromArray
methods.description: Creates an ArraySet from an array of elements.

methods.name: toVLQSigned
methods.description: Encodes a signed integer into VLQ format.

methods.name: fromVLQSigned
methods.description: Decodes a VLQ-encoded value into a signed integer.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a value into base64 VLQ format.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 VLQ character into a value.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a binary search on an array of mappings.

methods.name: generatedPositionAfter
methods.description: Checks if one generated position comes after another.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Adds a mapping to a SourceMapGenerator.

methods.name: setSourceContent
methods.description: Sets the content for a source file in the source map.

methods.name: applySourceMap
methods.description: Applies an existing source map to this source map.

methods.name: sourceContentFor
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a source file.

methods.name: originalPositionFor
methods.description: Returns the original position for a generated position.

methods.name: generatedPositionFor
methods.description: Returns the generated position for an original position.
